user_fields.darkMode_help: Enables the dark color scheme for the entire application.
user_fields.locale_help: Language of the user interface. Applied immediately.
user_fields.startupView_help: Which view is shown after login. Overrides the company default.
user_fields.fakturaCompactView_help: Hides detail cards (customer, document details, additional info) and shows a compact summary instead.
user_fields.defaultPrinter_help: Printer used by default for printouts
user_fields.accountingEasymode_help: Shows accounting in everyday wording: no debit and credit, no tax keys, only the work at hand. Switched off, the professional view appears. Can also be toggled directly in accounting.

UserSignature.title: Signature
UserSignature.hint: Photograph or scan your signature on white paper and upload it – also via Ctrl+V or drag and drop. The background is removed and the image cropped. It appears above the signature line in letters you sign.
UserSignature.drawHint: Sign with mouse, finger or pen.
UserSignature.unreadable: No signature could be detected in the image.
UserSignature.confirmRemove: Remove signature? Letters will get an empty line for a handwritten signature again.
